Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The speed-limit example list prints labels for some values only; the values whose road type did not come through in the extracted text were not taught, and only the labelled examples are stated [A02].
The page after the lane-use signals is a diagram of overhead freeway signs around a crash; it carries no rule text beyond what the previous page explains, so no fact cites it [A04].
The HOV page includes a graphic with a fine amount and an eligibility checklist; only the printed bullet rules and the line-marking rule were taught, and the graphic's values were not [A05].
The stopping-distance table's rows for the two highest speeds did not extract cleanly, so only the rows for the lower speeds that read clearly were taught [A07].
Statute numbers are kept only as short references; no statute text is copied.
